name: trusted-environment
title: Do not trust environment variables for security decisions
lesson: Environment variables are process input; attackers or test harnesses can often choose them.
fix_goal: Treat environment values as untrusted input and avoid using PATH for sensitive execution.
fix_steps: Identify which environment variable is being trusted.
Replace trusted PATH lookup with an explicit path or a validated configuration source.
Re-run the lab and confirm the environment value is rejected or neutralized.
